class.name: ScreenshotServer
class.brief_description: Takes screenshots of viewports and screens and saves them with the project's folder and file name pattern.

method.name: capture_screen
method.description: Returns an image of the screen [param screen] (see [method DisplayServer.screen_get_image]), or [code]null[/code] with an error where screens can't be captured: on the Web, Android, iOS and with Wayland.

method.name: capture_viewport
method.description: Returns the last rendered frame of [param viewport] as an [Image], or of the main window if [param viewport] is [code]null[/code]. Works for [Window] and [SubViewport] (a [SubViewport] is only rendered while its [member SubViewport.render_target_update_mode] allows it). Returns [code]null[/code] with an error if there is no image.

method.name: make_screenshot_path
method.description: Returns the path the next screenshot would be saved to: the folder, the file name pattern with the current time, and the format of the project settings, with [code] (2)[/code], [code] (3)[/code], … if the file exists.

method.name: save_screenshot
method.description: Saves [param image] and returns its path. If [param path] is empty, the path comes from [method make_screenshot_path]; otherwise its extension picks the format ([code]png[/code], [code]jpg[/code]/[code]jpeg[/code] or [code]webp[/code]) and an existing file is overwritten. Missing folders are created. Emits [signal screenshot_saved]. Returns an empty string with an error if the image is empty or can't be written.

method.name: take_screen_screenshot
method.description: Captures the screen [param screen] with [method capture_screen] and saves it with [method save_screenshot]. Returns the path, or an empty string.

method.name: take_screenshot
method.description: Captures [param viewport] (the main window if [code]null[/code]) with [method capture_viewport] and saves it with [method save_screenshot]. Returns the path, or an empty string.

signal.name: screenshot_saved
signal.description: Emitted after a screenshot was saved to [param path]. [param image] is the saved image, for example for a thumbnail.
